tools.name: scan_url
tools.description: Scan an authorized public app URL with a bounded, passive check for exposed keys, accessible Supabase/Firebase signals, public files, source maps and missing security headers. Returns a private scan ID, status URL and report_url. Requires owner_confirmed=true; the scan is read-only, does not log in

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Get grade, score, severity counts, the first bounded finding, coverage and report_url for a scan_id. Also returns unlock.url and one-time tier prices. Scan and report URLs are private capabilities; only show them to the authorized user. No raw target URL, evidence, row contents or paid prompts are r

tools.name: explain_finding
tools.description: Explain the first bounded finding in plain English with a safe verification step relevant to its check type. Requires a scan ID you already hold; it makes no additional target requests. Scan only apps you own or are authorized to test.
